# Calder documentation index

Calder is a transactional email API for application messages. See the live
pages below for the current contract and availability. Test keys simulate
sending; 202 Accepted is a queued request, not a delivery confirmation.

- Documentation: https://calder.click/docs
- Availability and launch limitations: https://calder.click/docs/availability
- Transactional email guide: https://calder.click/docs/transactional-email
- Troubleshoot delivery: https://calder.click/docs/email-delivery-troubleshooting
- cURL quickstart: https://calder.click/docs/quickstart/curl
- Node.js quickstart: https://calder.click/docs/quickstart/nodejs
- Sending: https://calder.click/docs/sending
- Domains: https://calder.click/docs/domains
- API reference: https://calder.click/docs/api-reference
- Idempotency: https://calder.click/docs/idempotency
- Webhooks: https://calder.click/docs/webhooks
- Usage and billing: https://calder.click/docs/usage-billing
- Pricing: https://calder.click/pricing
- Support: https://calder.click/support

Paid checkout is not available. SMTP is not available. Production Gmail OAuth
approval and configuration have not been verified. Consult the availability
page before relying on an integration or published SDK.
